 Madrid, Spain – Real Madrid fans are eagerly awaiting their team’s match against AEK Athens on Wednesday, in the fourth round of the Champions League group stage. The match comes amidst expectations of changes to the starting lineup, with Brazilian Vinicius Junior expected to return to the forward line after missing the last game.
 Real Madrid will visit AEK Athens for their match at Nea Philadelphia Stadium. The Spanish giants will be looking to secure a positive result and continue their journey in the continental competition.
 According to Spanish press reports, manager José Mourinho is expected to rest several players who have featured regularly in recent matches. Among them are Arda Güler and Aurélien Tchouaméni, who did not travel to Athens. This is part of anticipated changes to the squad.
 Reports also indicate that Yann Diomande, Bernardo Silva, Marc Cucurella, and Ibrahima Konaté could be on the bench. Denzel Dumfries’ name also features prominently in the expected starting lineup, despite his underwhelming performances this season and reduced playing time.
 Up front, Vinicius Junior is expected to reclaim his place in the starting lineup, alongside Kylian Mbappé and Brahim Díaz. This comes as Real Madrid look to bolster their attacking options against their Greek opponents.
 Real Madrid’s expected lineup against AEK Athens
 Goalkeeper: Thibaut Courtois.
 Defense: Denzel Dumfries, Antonio Rudiger, Dean Hoesen, Alvaro Carreras.
 Midfield: Fede Valverde, Eduardo Camavinga, Jude Bellingham.
 Attack: Brahim Diaz, Vinicius Junior, Kylian Mbappe.
